entities.summary: Daniela Gattelli is a former professional beach volleyball player from Italy who twice represented her native country at the Summer Olympics: 2000 and 2004. Partnering with Lucilla Perrotta, she claimed the gold medal at the 2002 European Championships in Basel, Switzerland.
